rules.name: Sensitive file access attempt
rules.description: Observed permission check for a sensitive file

rules.name: Connection to monitored destination
rules.description: TCP connect attempt to a lab destination on selected ports

rules.name: Suspicious tool execution
rules.description: Execution of a selected administrative or network utility

rules.name: Command interpreter with inline command
rules.description: Execution of a shell -c command; command content not inherently malicious

rules.name: Kubernetes credential file access
rules.description: Access to a service account token, kubeconfig or cluster admin credential; not proof of theft

rules.name: Capability change hook observed
rules.description: security_capset was invoked inside the workload; capabilities gained and syscall success are not established

rules.name: Namespace manipulation utility
rules.description: Execution of nsenter/unshare/setns-capable tooling; container escape not established

rules.name: Connection into private network
rules.description: TCP connection attempt into RFC1918 network; interaction with other services is not necessarily malicious

rules.name: Known mining program execution
rules.description: Execution of a binary commonly associated with cryptocurrency mining; verify workload allowlist

rules.name: Connection to common mining-pool port
rules.description: TCP connect attempt to a port often used by mining pools; ports are not definitive

rules.name: Kubernetes workload creation recorded
rules.description: Successful create of a workload through the Kubernetes API audit log; authorization must be assessed separately

rules.name: Container-runtime socket access
rules.description: Attempted access to container runtime control socket; may enable breakout depending on permissions

rules.name: Privilege management utility executed
rules.description: Execution of an administrative credential/capability tool; not proof of privilege escalation

rules.name: Internal network discovery utility
rules.description: Execution of network discovery tooling in container

rules.name: Process privilege raise recorded by Tetragon
rules.description: Tetragon reports a PRIVILEGES_RAISED_* exec property; confirm actual credentials, container context and authorization

rules.name: Possible internal network enumeration
rules.description: At least five distinct internal destinations within 30s from the same container; benign service discovery may match
